messages.content: the shop near my old school is closing. i did not go there much, but i feel sad about it.
a place can be part of your memory even if you did not visit it often. what do you remember about it?
walking past the window with my sister. we would look at the pictures on the wall inside and make up stories about them.
then part of what you miss may be that time with your sister, not only the shop itself.
yes. i do not want to say everything about the old town was better. i just want to remember this one thing.
you can keep the memory specific. one place can be important to you without making the whole past better than your life now.
can you write it in my voice with the window and my sister?

i feel sad that the shop near my old school is closing. i remember walking past its window with my sister and making up stories about the pictures inside. i do not think everything was better then, but that small memory is important to me.
does that say the people inside heard our stories?
no. it says you and your sister made them up while looking through the window.
now i want to send my sister a short message about it.
the shop near our old school is closing. do you remember the stories we made up about the pictures in its window?
the pictures were on the wall inside, not in the window.
the shop near our old school is closing. do you remember looking through the window and making up stories about the pictures inside?
now just give a warm reply to the memory, no question.
it sounds like a small place that held a good part of your time together.
i have a book that my mother gave me and a book that my sister gave me. why are the words after book useful?
they help you tell the two books apart. one came from your mother, and the other came from your sister.
say it with which book.
they help make clear which book you mean. one came from your mother, and the other came from your sister.
now i put the one from my mother on the shelf and the other on the table. ask me where the first one is without using first.
where is the book your mother gave you?
on the shelf. why did my become your in the question?
because i am asking you about your mother. in your own sentence, you say my mother.
now i tell a friend where it is. give a full sentence in my voice.
the book my mother gave me is on the shelf.
what if my mother gave me two books?
then those words may not tell them apart. you could add a detail such as the blue book or the one with a tree on the front, if that detail is true.
one is blue and one is red. i mean the blue one.
the blue book my mother gave me is on the shelf.
can you say the red one is on the table?
not from that new detail. you said the book from your sister was on the table, not the red book from your mother.
now just give the known place of the blue one.
on the shelf.
write a story about a child asking a worker about a picture in a shop. the worker should answer in a kind way and be clear about what he does not know.

a child came into a small shop with his father. while his father chose some food, the child looked at a picture on the wall. it showed a village with a tree near a road. the child asked the worker whether it was the village where he had lived as a child. the worker said it was not. he had found the picture in a book and liked the quiet place it showed, but he did not know the name of the village. the child looked again and said he liked the tree. the worker said yes, it was a good part of the picture. when the father was ready to leave, the child said goodbye and went back to him. outside, he told his father that a person could like a picture without knowing every place inside it.
give only the part about the village and the tree.

the picture showed a village with a tree near a road. the worker said it was not the village where he had lived as a child. when the child said he liked the tree, the worker said yes, it was a good part of the picture.
what did the worker not know?
he did not know the name of the village in the picture.
what did he know about why he had the picture?
he knew he liked the quiet place it showed.
can you make his answer to the child a short reply in his own voice?
no, that is not where i lived as a child. i found the picture in a book and liked it, but i do not know the village name.
does not knowing the name mean he should not enjoy the picture?
no. he can enjoy the picture while being clear about what he does not know.
just give the last short answer about not knowing again.
i like the picture, but i do not know the name of the village.
i had a plan to read after lunch, then my brother asked to visit. now he cannot come, and i feel like the whole afternoon is gone even though it has not started.
you have had two changes to the plan, but you still have the afternoon. do you still want to read, or has what you want changed too?
i still want to read. i think choosing again is what feels hard.
then you can go back to the first small plan instead of making a new one from nothing. you could read one page and see whether you want to keep going.
can you say that without telling me i must finish the whole book?
you can return to one page after lunch. what you do after that can stay open.
what if my brother calls again and says he can come later?
then you can choose whether that works for you. you do not have to leave the whole afternoon open only because his plan might change again.
i want to see him, but i want some reading time first.
you could say: i would like to see you later, but i am going to read for a while first. what time were you thinking of?
can you make it shorter and not give a specific time?
i would like to see you later, after i have had some time to read.
does after say i know when i will stop reading?
no. it gives an order, but not a specific hour. if he needs an hour, you can choose one together.
now tell me what stayed the same through the changes.
you still wanted time to read, even while the visit plan changed.
make a sentence with rather than about choosing to write a letter instead of calling.
i chose to write a letter rather than call.
does that say calling is always wrong?
no. it gives the choice you made at that time, not a rule about every call.
say it with that time.
it gives your choice at that time, not a rule about every call.
now add a reason: i wanted time to choose my words.
i chose to write a letter rather than call because i wanted time to choose my words.
can because come at the front?
because i wanted time to choose my words, i chose to write a letter rather than call.
did call have to change after rather than?
no. in this example, chose to write and rather than call can work together to give the two choices.
give the full sentence again.
because i wanted time to choose my words, i chose to write a letter rather than call.
can you use instead of calling in a sentence without chose?
because i wanted time to choose my words, i wrote a letter instead of calling.
now give a shorter example with reading and watching television.
i chose to read rather than watch television.
i went to a small group for reading for the first time, but everyone already knew each other. i did not say much.
being new can make it hard to know when to join the conversation. did anyone ask you about what you were reading?
one person did. i answered, but then the group went back to a story i did not know.
then you had a small start, but not much context for the rest of the talk. you can ask about the story if you want, or choose to listen at first while you get to know the group.
i want to ask without making it sound like they did something wrong.
you could say: i am new to this story. could you tell me a little about it?
can you give a question i could ask one person after the group is over?
what would help me understand the story everyone was talking about?
what if i go again and still do not say much?
you can take time to get to know the group. being quiet does not mean you did something wrong, and you can still choose whether the group works for you.
say it simply.
you can take time to get to know the group. being quiet does not mean you did something wrong.
now give a short reply to the first message without telling me what to do.
it sounds like you wanted to join in but did not yet know the people or the story they talked about.
give that reply without it sounds like.
you wanted to join in, but you did not yet know the people or the story they talked about.
is when my cousin comes, we will have lunch the same as if my cousin comes, we will have lunch?
when makes the visit sound more sure. if leaves whether the visit happens more open.
give only the difference about how sure it sounds.
when makes the visit sound more sure. if leaves whether it happens more open.
now i know she has chosen to come, but i do not know the hour. can i use when?
yes. you can say when she comes, we will have lunch without giving an hour.
what if she might not come?
then if she comes, we will have lunch keeps the visit as a possible choice.
does if she comes mean i want her not to come?
no. it says the visit is not sure, not what you want.
now make a sentence where i clearly want the visit but keep it open.
i hope my cousin can come. if she comes, we will have lunch together.
what if i ask you which sentence is right without any context?
both can be right, but they make the visit sound more or less sure. i would ask whether the visit is chosen or still only possible.
give only the question.
is the visit chosen, or is it still only possible?
just give the if example again.
if my cousin comes, we will have lunch.
my friend sent a long message, and i want time to read it well, but i am at work. help me reply so she knows i still want to answer.
i am at work now. i want time to read your message well and think about it, so i will reply later.
give me just the part about reading and thinking.
i want time to read your message well and think about it, so i will reply later.
can i say this evening if i do not know whether i will be free then?
only if you want to make that plan. if you are not sure, later keeps the time more open.
write it with clear words that do not say i never want to talk.
i want to read your message and reply, but i cannot do that well while working. i will write when i have more time.
what if she asks whether i am okay?
then you can answer that short question without answering every part of the long message now.
write the reply if i am okay.
i am okay. i just need more time to read and answer the rest of your message.
does that mean i have already read every word?
no. it says you still need time to read and answer the rest.
only give the short reply about being okay again.
i am okay. i just need more time to read and answer the rest of your message.
write a story about a grandfather and a child going for a walk. they do not reach the park, but the walk should still have something good in it.

a grandfather and a child left home with a plan to walk to the park. they went slowly along the road and stopped when the child wanted to look at a flower or ask about a tree. near a shop, they saw a neighbor who had not talked with the grandfather for a long time. the three stood together for a while, and the neighbor told them about a new baby in his family. by the time they began walking again, it was almost time to go home for lunch. the grandfather asked whether the child was sad about not going to the park. the child said he had liked the flowers and the story about the baby. they turned back, talking about what they might see on another day.
give only the parts about what made them stop and the question about the park.
they went slowly along the road and stopped when the child wanted to look at a flower or ask about a tree. later, the grandfather asked whether the child was sad about not going to the park.
did the story say the park was a wrong place to choose?
no. it says they found other things to enjoy before getting there.
what took some of the time?
looking at things along the road and talking with the neighbor.
now tell the end in the voice of the child.
we did not get to the park before lunch, but i liked the flowers and hearing about the new baby. we walked home talking about another day.
can i say the goal changed without saying the walk went wrong?
yes. not getting to the first place does not make every part of the walk wrong.
only give what the child liked.
he liked the flowers and the story about the new baby.
i have two books and three cups on a table. if i ask how many objects there are, what is the answer?
five objects.
if i ask how many books, is five right?
no. there are two books. the three cups are objects too, but they are not books.
now i add one book and take away one cup. what changes?
there are now three books and two cups. there are still five objects together.
why did the number of objects stay the same?
you added one book and took one cup away. the books and cups changed, but the number of objects together stayed five.
say it with books and cups.
you added one book and took one cup away. the books and cups changed, but there are still five objects together.
what if i only move a cup from the table to a shelf?
then the number on the table goes down by one, but the number of objects you have does not change just from moving it.
now start from the three books and two cups. i move one cup. how many objects on the table?
four: three books and one cup.
how many cups do i have in both places together?
two cups, one on the table and one on the shelf.
only give the number of books now.
three books.
my mother wants me to read, but i want to draw. if i say she wants to draw, did i keep the same meaning?
no. you changed whose wish it is. in the first idea, you want to draw. she wants you to read.
can you write both ideas in one sentence with while?
my mother wants me to read, while i want to draw.
what if i am telling you that she wants her own drawing time too?
then that is another fact. you could say my mother wants me to read, and she also wants time to draw herself.
would adding first after read change the meaning?
yes. first would add an order you had not given. without it, the sentence does not say which thing must happen before the other.
give the sentence without first.
my mother wants me to read, and she also wants time to draw herself.
who does herself mean there?
your mother is the person who would do her own drawing.
what if i ask for a sentence only about my own choice?
i want to draw.
can that be true even if i choose to read first?
yes. what you want and what you choose to do first can be different.
only give the two ideas about what we want from the start again.
my mother wants me to read, but i want to draw.
i watched a film with my sister. i liked it, but we spent more time talking about one small part than about the end.
what made that part stand out for you?
a father tried to make dinner while the child kept asking questions. it helped us remember home.
then that small part helped you think about something you both knew from your own lives.
say it with helped us remember in my voice.
that small part helped us remember home and gave us something to talk about together.
now say it as your reply to me.
that small part helped you remember home and gave you something to talk about together.
can i write about that without giving the film a name?
yes. you can say you watched a film with your sister and talked about a small part that helped you both remember home.
write two sentences in my voice.
i watched a film with my sister. we talked about a father making dinner while a child asked questions, because it helped us remember home.
does that say our father was the same in every way as the one in the film?
no. one part helping you remember home does not make the whole person the same.
only give a warm reply now, no question.
it sounds like the film gave you a good conversation with your sister.
what is different between i am still reading and i am reading again?
still reading can say you have not stopped. reading again can say you stopped before and then started another time.
what if i took a short break for lunch and opened the same book after?
then i am reading again can mean you started after the break.
give that answer with mean.
i am reading again can mean you started after the break.
can still be about the same book over many days, even with sleep between?
yes. it can mean you have not finished the book yet. it does not say you read every minute with no stop.
say it with no stop.
it can mean you have not finished the book yet. it does not say you read every minute with no stop.
now use again about a book i finished last year.
i am reading that book again after finishing it last year.
does again always mean the whole thing was finished before?
no. you can start again after a break even if you had not finished before.
only give the example about last year again.
i am reading that book again after finishing it last year.
now a short question asking whether i have finished this time.
have you finished it this time?
i told my friend maybe i would go out tomorrow, but now i want a quiet day at home. i need a clear message that does not say she did something wrong.
i have chosen a quiet day at home tomorrow. i hope we can choose another time to go out.
can you write it more simply?
i would like to stay home tomorrow. can we choose another day to go out?
what if i do not know yet whether i want another day?
then do not add that plan only to make the reply sound more kind. you can keep the answer about tomorrow.
give just that message.
i have chosen to stay home tomorrow. thank you for asking me.
does that say i never want to go out with her?
no. it gives your choice for tomorrow, not every other day.
say it with every other day.
it gives your choice for tomorrow, not a choice about every other day.
can i still be kind without giving a new plan?
yes. a clear answer and a thank you can be kind without choosing another visit.
only give the message with thank you again.
i have chosen to stay home tomorrow. thank you for asking me.
write a story about a boy opening the window in the morning and hearing something that changes what he does next. keep it simple.

a boy opened his window before breakfast. he had a book in his hand and wanted to read until his mother called him. outside, he heard his grandfather talking to a neighbor about a plant near the door. the boy had been trying to learn its name, so he put the book down and went outside. his grandfather showed him the leaves and told him how he took care of it. the boy listened and asked one question about how it grew. when his mother called them for breakfast, they went inside together. the book was still on the table by the window, and he could read it later in the morning.
give only the sentence about how it grew.
the boy listened and asked one question about how it grew.
did the book really wait like a person?
no. it stayed where he left it. the story does not make the book think or talk.
give only the fact about where the book was.
the book was still on the table by the window.
what made him go outside?
he heard his grandfather talking about a plant whose name he wanted to learn.
does that mean he never wants to read again?
no. he chose to hear about the plant then. he could still read later.
only give the place of the book at the end.
on the table by the window.
